snippet.title: Frogreign - Official Gameplay Trailer | A Metroidvania where your tongue is your Grappling hook!
snippet.description:
Leap into an amphibious adventure where your tongue is your grappling hook! Use your tongue to swing, slap and grapple your way through this vibrant Metroidvania.

Will you help prince Rill to unlock the power of the great spirits and find his sister, lost in the midst of a royal conspiracy?

Learn more about Frogreign: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2468430/Frogreign/

Join our community: https://discord.com/invite/vuY4thycPK
